integrity: A complete mathematical proof is supplied, with a standalone pure-Python exact transfer-matrix characteristic-polynomial checker and independent small-graph enumeration. The computational checks corroborate but do not substitute for the unrestricted induction. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
limitations: For labelled cubic prisms and Möbius ladders with n >= 3 only. Counts unordered nonempty degree-two-cut bipartitions; not cut-size distributions, general cubic graph counts, or cuts modulo graph automorphisms. Historical priority is provisional.
title: A six-periodic seam law for degree-two cuts of cubic ladders
